title: Corey Scholes, PhD
text:
Scientist | cscholes181@gmail.com | +61 411 032 987 | linkedin.com/in/coreyscholes


Scientist and research professional with a passion for uncovering insights from data to solve problems. Skilled in SQL, Matlab, Stata, R and Quarto with a strong background in statistical analysis.





July 2016 - Present

Medical research consultancy servicing clients globally
Design, implement and provide ongoing support to clinical quality registries




January 2019 - Present

Supervise all scientific activities undertaken by EBMA
Conduct technical analyses for ongoing and periodic engagements
Maintain reporting and analysis infrastructure




October 2009 - September 2016

Not-for-profit organisation dedicated to clinical research in orthopaedics
Plan, lead and manage operational and research activities
Support clinician founders with advice and technical support to maintain the Institute







2005 - 2009
PhD in functional anatomy and biomechanics, School of Human Movement Studies, Faculty of Health and the Institute of Health and Biomedical Innovation.

2004
Bachelor of Applied Science (Honours)





Data Analysis: SQL, R

Statistical Analysis: STATA, R





Good Clinical Practice

Conducted customer segmentation analysis using clustering techniques to enhance targeted marketing campaigns.
